I added `scripts/plot_revenue.py` and ran it. It reads `data/sales.csv` and writes a line chart of monthly revenue to a PNG. I opened the PNG and it looks right: 12 months, with the last point labelled $71,800.

- **Test output:** I wrote the PNG to `/tmp/revenue_check.png`, so nothing new was added to the repo besides the script.
- **Usage:** `python3 scripts/plot_revenue.py [--csv PATH] [--out PATH]`. If you leave `--out` off, it writes `revenue.png` in the repo root.
- **Dependencies:** pandas isn't installed here, so the script uses only the standard library `csv` module plus matplotlib, which is installed (3.9.4).
- **Not checked:** I didn't run the colour validator from the dataviz skill on the line colour. It's a single series, so the palette checks don't really apply.

The 2026-12 row is dated after today (2026-11-28), so it may be a forecast or placeholder. The chart plots it like any other month.
